products.name: CrewAI
products.note: Multi-agent framework; agent collaboration; task delegation; emerging governance patterns

reading.body:
CrewAI provides a framework that automates business processes by deploying multiple AI agents to collaborate on tasks like lead enrichment, ticket handling, and data consolidation, reducing labor cost per workflow step.

The company's product combines agent orchestration with pattern matching across billions of runs, a feature it calls CrewAI Discovery. This pattern-matching layer suggests the core value proposition: reducing the manual work of identifying which tasks are worth automating and how much effort each requires. The named customers span recruitment, education, document processing, and food production, indicating adoption across sectors where task delegation has clear ROI.

CrewAI is a developer tool, not an infrastructure provider. It depends on compute supplied elsewhere, typically cloud GPU or API endpoints. The data does not reveal where its own training or inference runs, its customer deployment sizes, or how much compute its framework consumes per agent deployed. It also does not show revenue, headcount, or whether the company operates profitably. These gaps matter because CrewAI's actual demand signal for AI hardware depends on how many agents run simultaneously across its customers, not merely on the fact that customers use it.

profile_text.body:
CrewAI is a multi-agent framework listed among coding and developer tools, with a focus on agent collaboration, task delegation, and emerging governance patterns. Its website describes CrewAI Discovery, which it says matches patterns observed over billions of agent runs against a customer's tickets, chats, apps, and workflows to produce a list of automation opportunities ranked by effort, value, and readiness.

The site cites several organizations using crews of AI agents. Gelato is described as improving lead quality and prioritization with agents that enrich leads with data on company size, printer infrastructure, and revenue estimates. General Assembly is described as streamlining and scaling curriculum design with agents that generate lesson content and instructor guides. Docusign is described as accelerating lead time-to-first-contact by extracting, consolidating, and evaluating lead data from multiple internal systems. Piracanjuba is described as improving customer support ticket response time and accuracy by replacing legacy RPA tooling with a crew of AI agents.

The record holds no litigation, no MCP servers, and no SEC or patent facts for the company.
